verdict.rationale: The Moss GitHub README states that the product offers metadata filtering, so some first-party filtering exists. Nothing in the pack describes the filter syntax or any of the rich operators the story names; min_score relevance thresholds are a different control and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filters, nested boolean (AND/OR/NOT) logic, array-membership operators, a filter query syntax reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries
